messages.subject: For Mohammed Saif Al-Sowaidi | Sovereign investment, government partnerships and global strategy
messages.body:
Dear Qatar Investment Authority Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Mohammed Saif Al-Sowaidi, Chief Executive Officer.

QIA's global investment mandate requires disciplined understanding of governments, strategic sectors, sustainability and long-horizon partnerships across diverse markets. That intersection aligns strongly with the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate cross-functional execution across complex regulated environments.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, stakeholder strategy and emerging-market operating experience might support QIA's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Qatar Investment Authority.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
